name: inositol polyphosphate-4-phosphatase type II B
pathways: regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction

function.text: INPP4B encodes inositol polyphosphate 4-phosphatase type II. Annotated molecular activities include inositol-1,3,4-trisphosphate 4-phosphatase activity and inositol-3,4-bisphosphate 4-phosphatase activity. It participates in signal transduction and regulation of phosphatidylinositol 3-kinase/protein kinase B signal transduction.
